correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable contract from the diff: PR-number and env validation, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, GraphQL snapshots for reviews and reviewThreads, head SHA checks before and after each snapshot, and RESULT=/HEAD= emission on all five exit branches with documented codes. CONVERGED requires zero PENDING reviews and zero unresolved allow-listed bot threads on the current head; QUIET_ELAPSED uses elapsed quiet time from allow-listed review and thread timestamps. Two-point deduction for contract gaps visible in the patch: CONVERGED fires when pending=0 and threads=0 even if no allow-listed bot has participated on the current head (immediate converge with zero bot activity), and GraphQL fetches are capped at first:100 without pagination, which can miss state on busy PRs.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent: set -euo pipefail, structured finish/api_error helpers, jq-based snapshot analysis, and an eight-file focused diff. Documentation is synced across AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, scripts/README.md, and pr-resolve-all.md including helper preference, exit-contract handling, time-based fallback preservation, and canonical allow-list pointer with mirrored entries. Deductions for ~240 lines of inline GraphQL/jq logic without extracted scripts/lib/jq helpers used elsewhere in the repo, and no op-issue-workflow.md companion cross-reference present in stronger candidates.

process.rationale: Diff stays focused on the helper, allow-list, bats tests, check wiring, and required doc/prompt companions with no AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or state-surface churn; objective process scored 15/15. pr-resolve-all.md prefers the helper while preserving the documented time-based fallback and renumbers round disciplines consistently. Required doc companions (2/2) and scripts README maintenance are evident in files-changed.txt.
